unruled:ny_city_rs#1.evidence: ny_it201i p. 4, Item A. A joint return with a spouse who was not a full-year New York State and City resident is refused: ny_it201.gate.spouse_nonresident (federal status mfj and ny_it201.ask.spouse_resident No).

unruled:ny_it2#1.evidence: ny_it201i p. 21, Form IT-2: a W-2c's corrected amounts are not asked for, and the IT-2 record required for foreign income received without a Form W-2 is neither built nor refused. Rare; low.

unruled:ny_rs#1.evidence: ny_it201i p. 4, Item A. As ny_city_rs#1: the mixed-residency joint return is refused by ny_it201.gate.spouse_nonresident.

unruled:ny_it201#1.evidence: ny_it201i pp. 5-6, Item A, filing status 3: "You are unable to file a joint New York return because: – the address or whereabouts of your spouse is unknown ..." and "your spouse refuses to sign a joint New York return". As the earlier ny_it201#1 ruling (the same situation; this claim adds the item H note): a filer on a joint federal return who must file separately for New York is not asked about and not refused; the New York return follows the federal status. Rare; low; BUG-0424.

unruled:ny_it201#2.evidence: ny_it201i p. 11, Lines 37 and 38: "If line 36 is more than line 35, leave line 37 and line 38 blank." ny_it201.line37 is subtract_floor0 of line 35 and line 36 (type NonNegDollars), so it is zero, never negative, when the dependent exemptions exceed line 35, and its note reads the blank as zero; line 38 copies it. The claim's negative flow to lines 38, 47 and 69a does not occur.
